stem: Based on this image, how did the Black Panther Party differ from Martin Luther King Jr. and his followers?

options.label: A
options.text: The Black Panther Party focused attention only on issues in southern states.

options.label: B
options.text: The Black Panther Party believed in achieving equal voting rights for all.

options.label: C
options.text: The Black Panther Party advocated militant action to achieve its goals.

options.label: D
options.text: The Black Panther Party worked willingly with government officials.
